content: For a small, unlikely-to-change value set (risk_tolerance: Conservative/Moderate/Aggressive; time_horizon: 5 buckets) Postgres CHECK constraints are preferred over native ENUM types in an evolving app: CHECK constraints avoid ACCESS EXCLUSIVE table locks and awkward ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE migration friction that native enums impose (enum values also cannot be removed once created). Recommended Supabase-safe pattern: add the CHECK constraint as NOT VALID first (instant, no lock), then VALIDATE CONSTRAINT in a background step. For text columns, use 'text' with a CHECK (col in (...)) rather than 'varchar(n)'.
